cases.test: a discarded document flushes its pending mutation and the cold reload reads it back
cases.drives: adopted campaign -> Advance Day on the dashboard (header date change polled) -> assert ZERO campaign PUTs so far (still inside the 2 s debounce) -> page.goto('about:blank') discards the document
asserts: server record version == baseline + 1 (polled, 20 s budget)
exactly ONE campaign PUT observed via page.on('request')
after page.addInitScript(() => localStorage.clear()) and a reload of the dashboard, the rendered header date equals the date captured before the discard
cases.coldReloadStrength: localStorage is cleared at DOCUMENT START, so the rehydrated client cache cannot supply the value; the rendered date can only come from the server record the flush wrote.

cases.test: a surviving document takes the ordinary debounced save, exactly once
asserts: it arrived more than 1000 ms after the mutation (the debounce, not a discard)
server version == baseline + 1 and currentDate changed
the 'Unsaved changes' badge is hidden -- the ordinary save IS an acknowledgement, which the flush deliberately is not

cases.test: a hidden transition flushes without acknowledging, and returning re-arms a save

asserts: exactly one PUT fires on the hidden transition
the 'Unsaved changes' badge is STILL visible -- the flush never read its response and so never cleared the pending mutations
on the visible transition a further PUT is issued (>= 2 total)

Same Advance Day, same about:blank discard, then a 4 s wait past the debounce.
asserts: server record version UNCHANGED from baseline
server record body.currentDate UNCHANGED from baseline
cases.verdict: Discrimination proven: with the listeners the mutation reaches the server, without them it does not. This is the red arm the brief asked for; it is kept as a permanent in-file test rather than a one-off run.

findings.title: A flush the document SURVIVES leaves the client unable to acknowledge: the reconciled save is refused 409
findings.measured: Case (c) asserts and observes HTTP 409 on the reconciliation PUT (pinned as RECONCILE_PUT_STATUS in the spec, and also recorded as a testInfo annotation `reconcile-put-status`).
findings.mechanism: flushPendingMutations deliberately does not advance baseVersion (task 1.6: 'do NOT clear dirty, do NOT advance baseVersion'). When the flush LANDS, the server row goes N -> N+1 while the client's compare-and-swap token stays N. reconcileAfterDiscardFlush then arms the ordinary save, which PUTs baseVersion N against a row at N+1, and the strict CAS in CampaignPersistenceService.ts:126-131 refuses it.
findings.specTension: The scenario added by #1694 -- 'A hidden transition the document survives still reaches an acknowledged save' -- says the client SHALL schedule an ordinary ACKNOWLEDGED save. In a real browser only the scheduling half holds; the save is refused, and the dashboard surfaces 'Save refused ... take the server version'. Not data loss (the flush already wrote the state), but a user-visible conflict banner produced by the fix's own successful write.
findings.reachability: Every ordinary tab switch / minimise / app switch on a dirty single-player campaign.
findings.notFixedHere: This prefix is a proof, not a change. No product code was touched. Filing or owning the remedy is a decision for the parent.

findings.title: The keepalive flush's own request is reported net::ERR_ABORTED and is FATAL to the shared e2e diagnostics gate
findings.measured: run2.log event 5: `requestfailed ... PUT http://localhost:3639/api/campaigns/<id> ... net::ERR_ABORTED`, on a run whose functional assertions proved the same write LANDED (version + 1, cold reload rendered the mutated date).
findings.mechanism: e2e/helpers/browserDiagnosticsModel.ts:59-62 classes an ERR_ABORTED on a non-GET /api/ request as fatal, on the (correct, pre-existing) rule that a save cancelled by navigation is silent data loss. A discard-time keepalive write is exactly that shape but is not that bug.
findings.handledHere: The spec's local `withGate` allows this ONE event class in the discard test only, and compensates with the server-side record read plus the cold reload. Any future spec that navigates away with a dirty campaign will hit the same classification.

findings.title: The equipment catalogue loader logs an aborted static read as 'missing, unreadable, or malformed'
findings.measured: run2.log / run3.log: `[EquipmentOfficialLoader] Failed to load weapons from weapons/ballistic-gauss.json (missing, unreadable, or malformed)` paired one-for-one with a net::ERR_ABORTED GET of that /data/equipment/ file, each time a navigation happened within about a second of a page load.
findings.impact: A console error, therefore fatal to every diagnostics-gated spec that navigates quickly. Unrelated to campaign persistence; pre-existing at c40a394f6 (the catalogue shipped in #1636, the commit two before this branch's base).
findings.handledHere: Narrow allowance in this spec's gate, by console-text prefix or /data/equipment/ url -- never by widening the gate.

nonClaims: `keepalive` is NOT directly observable from Playwright. The flag lives on the RequestInit, never on the wire, and request.headers() does not carry it. This spec proves the WRITE LANDED across a document discard and proves the listeners are load-bearing (red arm); it does not read the flag.
Single-player only. Every case runs a non-co-op campaign; isCoopCampaign is the flush's own skip condition and is untested here. Residual (2), the co-op dual-writer PUT 409 storm, is untouched.
No co-op, no journal authority, no flag flip, no command pipeline. CAMPAIGN_JOURNAL_AUTHORITY_ENABLED was not set for these runs.
The 64 KiB over-cap skip (`envelope-over-keepalive-cap`) is NOT exercised in the browser: the seeded campaigns are far under the cap. That row remains jsdom-only.
`beforeunload` is not covered, by design -- the fix deliberately does not register it.

A real browser crash / kill is not simulated. `page.goto('about:blank')` is a document discard that fires pagehide; a process kill that fires neither event still loses the window, exactly as the task's own NON-CLAIMS say.
Chromium only. No Firefox or WebKit run; keepalive behaviour on discard is engine-specific.

The seeding path uses adoptLegacyCampaign through the E2E-exposed store, not the campaign wizard. It produces a server-held, adopted campaign, which is the precondition under test; it is not a claim about how a user's first campaign reaches the server.
No push, no PR, no merge. Task 1.6's checkbox is NOT flipped and no openspec file was edited.
F1's 409 is reported, not fixed: no product code was changed in this prefix.
